content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

Imagine being able to sell your ebooks, courses, templates, and fonts to anyone in the world, without the hassle of dealing with payment gateways that don't work in your country or charge exorbitant fees. That's exactly what happens when you deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, built specifically for creators like you who need a reliable and cost-effective way to sell digital products online. With this architecture, you're not just selling products – you're taking back control of your infrastructure, and that's a game-changer.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At the heart of this infrastructure is NOWPayments, a crypto payment processing system that charges a mere 0.5% fee on every sale. When a customer buys a digital product from your store, NOWPayments automatically verifies the payment on-chain, without the need for any intermediate gateways. This means you get to keep 99.5% of your earnings, which can add up to a significant amount over time. For example, at 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference with Gumroad would retain $921.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This sovereign digital commerce stack is built specifically for creators who are tired of being held back by payment gateways that don't work in their countries or charge too much. Whether you're in Zimbabwe, Ghana, Kenya, or any other country where Stripe or Gumroad are blocked, this architecture gives you the freedom to sell digital products online, without the hassle of dealing with payment gateways that don't work for you.
With a sovereign digital commerce stack, you get to keep 99.5% of your earnings.
The Components That Make It Work Together

So, what makes up this sovereign digital commerce stack? At its core, it's built on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Each component works together seamlessly to create a robust and scalable infrastructure that's completely under your control.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Ready to take back control of your online store and payment processing? With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you get all 6 blueprints plus all 7 templates, everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. Instant download. Worth $348 separately, this kit is a game-changer for creators who want to sell digital products online without the hassle of dealing with payment gateways that don't work for them.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
You have complete control over your infrastructure and payment processing.

If you're looking for a reliable and cost-effective way to sell digital products online, without the hassle of dealing with payment gateways that don't work in your country or charge too much, then this post is for you. Check out the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. And when you're ready to shop, head over to https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack today, follow these concrete steps: purchase the Complete Builder Kit ($197) and download the 6 blueprints plus 7 templates; deploy the GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages hosting; set up NOWPayments for crypto payment processing; configure Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic; store orders in Supabase or Google Sheets; and deliver files via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. With these steps, you'll be up and running in no time.
